title: Shopify REST Admin API marked legacy
summary: Official Shopify documentation describes the REST Admin API as legacy and directs developers toward GraphQL Admin API. April 1, 2025 is an applicability date for new public apps, not a universal REST removal deadline.
migration_path: Use GraphQL Admin API according to current Shopify guidance; verify version-specific REST support requirements for existing integrations.
user_impact: Developers using REST Admin API should plan migration and check current Shopify requirements.
notes: Stage 7 corrected the earlier over-broad deadline interpretation.
